spectral.true_color: High confidence: fields range from medium and dark green to tan and gray-brown. Settlement is a mottled mixture of gray, white, green, and dark pixels. A few compact surfaces are conspicuously bright. Dark linear margins contrast with smooth fields; medium confidence that these combine woody vegetation and shadow.
spectral.false_color: High confidence: northern fields and much of the large west-central field have strong red responses. Settlement vegetation forms smaller red patches among cyan-gray roofs and roads. The upper tan field and southwestern fields are relatively muted gray-green, while the elongated southeastern enclosure has a weaker reddish-brown response.

implications.claim: Strong red field responses indicate substantial live vegetation with relatively high near-infrared reflectance.
Differences in red intensity probably reflect a combination of canopy cover, growth stage, vegetation type, and soil background; they do not uniquely measure plant health.
Tan fields with weak red responses likely have more exposed soil, dry residue, or sparse vegetation than adjacent bright-red fields.
Bright neutral or cyan patches within the settlement are consistent with roofs and paved surfaces.
Dark parcels and margins could contain dense vegetation, shadow, or darker soil; elevated moisture is only one possible explanation.
No sizeable open-water body is confidently visible, so water turbidity cannot be assessed.

spectral.not_revealed: High confidence: these displayed composites cannot provide calibrated reflectance, numerical vegetation indices, soil moisture, water turbidity, crop species, yield, management dates, or change rates. They also cannot reliably separate moisture stress from phenology or establish irrigation. Image stretching and mixed pixels limit quantitative comparison of displayed colors.

interpretation.claim: The patch represents an agricultural–settlement mosaic with a substantial residential component.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1–3; all cells, especially middle_left versus middle_right and bottom_center: large bounded fields contrast with repeated buildings, roads, and gardens.

interpretation.claim: Some fields are likely managed grassland or actively growing crops, while others have little live canopy.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2 and 4; middle_left and top_center show strong red responses, contrasting with tan, muted parcels in top_left and bottom_left.

interpretation.claim: The low-cover parcels could be tilled, harvested, recently sown, or seasonally senescent; the specific management state is unresolved.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2 and 4; top_left, top_center, bottom_left, and bottom_center contain smooth tan surfaces with weak near-infrared display responses.

interpretation.claim: Crop species and crop rotation cannot be identified from this single-date pair.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2–4; agricultural cells show parcel-scale spectral differences but no diagnostic crop morphology or temporal sequence.

interpretation.claim: Woody cover appears concentrated along boundaries and within settlement rather than in extensive forest blocks.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1–3; top_left, middle_center, and bottom_right show narrow dark margins and scattered vegetation without a broad continuous forest canopy.

interpretation.claim: Field margins and gardens may provide vegetated connections through the managed landscape, but ecological condition and biodiversity cannot be established.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2–4; middle_center, middle_right, and bottom_right contain linear vegetation and red garden patches between fields and buildings.

interpretation.claim: There is no clear image evidence of active irrigation, flooding, major erosion, or recent extensive clearing.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 2–4; all cells lack an identifiable flood footprint, erosion network, irrigation apparatus, or large fresh clearing. Small or obscured processes remain possible.

interpretation.claim: A temperate agricultural setting is plausible, but biome and climate are weakly constrained.
interpretation.evidence: Levels 1 and 4; green fields, woody boundaries, and settlement gardens are compatible with a temperate managed landscape but are not geographically diagnostic.

summaries.w25: High confidence: fields and settlement form a heterogeneous mosaic. Medium confidence: contrasting vegetation responses reflect different canopy cover or growth stages.
summaries.w50: High confidence: large agricultural parcels dominate the west and north, while buildings, roads, and gardens concentrate eastward and southward. Strong false-color red marks live vegetation. Medium confidence: tan, muted fields have sparse canopy or dry residue. Crop identities, management timing, and moisture remain unresolved.
summaries.w100: High confidence: this 1.2 km patch contains a heterogeneous agricultural–settlement mosaic. Large fields occupy the west and north; buildings, roads, and gardens concentrate in the east and lower center. Northern parcels and the broad west-central field show strong near-infrared vegetation responses. Medium confidence: tan fields contain exposed soil, dry residues, or sparse vegetation, indicating differing management or growth stages. Woody vegetation appears mainly along boundaries and within settlement. No sizeable open water is confidently identified. High confidence: these renderings cannot establish crop species, rotation, soil moisture, or active irrigation, and individual buildings are often mixed at 10 m.
summaries.w200:
High confidence: large agricultural fields and a substantial settlement form a heterogeneous mosaic across this 1.2 km patch. Open parcels dominate the west and north, while buildings, roads, and gardens occupy much of the east and lower center. Medium-confidence visual estimates allocate 40% to vegetated fields and grassland, 23% to low-cover fields, 20% to predominantly impervious surfaces, 10% to settlement vegetation, and 7% to woody cover and margins.

High confidence: northern fields and the broad west-central parcel show strong false-color red responses, indicating substantial live vegetation. Tan parcels in the upper-left and southwest have much weaker responses. Medium confidence: these differences reflect canopy cover, phenology, and management, potentially including exposed soil or dry residues. A north–south road organizes the eastern settlement, with diagonal connecting corridors visible at medium confidence.

Medium confidence: woody vegetation is mostly linear or scattered, and an elongated enclosure occupies the southeast. No sizeable open water is confidently identified. A temperate setting is plausible at low confidence. High confidence: crop species, rotation, quantitative moisture, and recent change cannot be determined; small buildings, hedges, and roads are affected by mixed pixels.
summaries.w400:
High confidence: this 1.2 km Sentinel-2 patch depicts a heterogeneous agricultural–settlement mosaic. Large fields occupy the west and north, while fine-grained buildings, roads, gardens, and small plots concentrate in the east and lower center. Medium-confidence visual cover estimates are 40% vegetated agricultural fields and open grassland, 23% bare or weakly vegetated fields, 20% predominantly impervious surfaces, 10% settlement vegetation, and 7% woody vegetation and dark margins. These estimates are approximate because many settlement pixels contain multiple covers.

High confidence: the broad west-central field is relatively smooth and strongly red in the near-infrared composite. Northern fields also show strong red responses. The upper-left tan field and southwestern parcels are more muted, consistent at medium confidence with exposed soil, dry residues, sparse crops, or senescent vegetation. Differences in displayed red intensity reflect several factors and cannot uniquely diagnose plant health or moisture.

High confidence: agricultural parcels have sharp angular boundaries, contrasting with the mottled settlement. Medium confidence: a main north–south road crosses the eastern third, diagonal lanes connect the center and southwest, and several dark field margins contain hedges or other woody vegetation. A conspicuous bright roof or hardstanding complex lies near the upper central transition into settlement. An elongated, comparatively weakly vegetated enclosure occupies the southeast. Individual building counts and narrow corridor widths cannot be resolved reliably.

Medium confidence: the scene contains managed grassland or crops alongside low-cover parcels at different growth or management stages. Specific crop types, harvest status, and rotation are unresolved. Woody cover appears concentrated along boundaries and within gardens, without extensive forest blocks. Vegetated margins may provide ecological connections, but biodiversity and habitat quality cannot be assessed. A temperate agricultural setting is plausible only at low confidence.

No sizeable open-water body is confidently visible, and water turbidity cannot be assessed. Medium confidence: there is no clear evidence of flooding, active irrigation, major erosion, or extensive recent clearing. Absence of visible evidence does not exclude small or concealed activity. High confidence: display stretching, native 10 m resolution, and mixed pixels prevent quantitative moisture or reflectance interpretation. A small saturated multicolor spot near the lower center has an uncertain origin. Single-date imagery cannot establish management timing, change rates, or climate.
